market_definition: Construction Joint Sealants comprises sealant products used to close and protect movement, expansion, control and connection joints in building and civil-engineering structures. The scope is defined by joint-sealing use across construction substrates. By Chemistry • Silicone • Polyurethane • Acrylic • Polysulfide • MS Polymer By Joint Type • Expansion Joints • Control Joints • Perimeter Joints • Facade Joints By Substrate • Concrete • Glass and Metal • Masonry • Timber By Application • Above-Grade • Below-Grade • Roofing and Facade • Flooring By End Use • Residential • Commercial • Infrastructure • Industrial Construction By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Adhesives used solely for bonding, waterproofing membranes, grout, joint fillers sold without sealant function and sealants for non-construction uses. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
